items.heading: Khinkali
details: Key ingredients: dumpling dough, minced meat, onion, broth
Mix minced meat with onion, broth and spices for a juicy filling.
Wrap the filling in circles of dough, pleating and twisting the top into a knot.
Boil the dumplings until they float and the dough is cooked through.
Eat by hand, sipping the broth inside before finishing each dumpling.

items.heading: Khachapuri
details: Key ingredients: bread dough, cheese, egg, butter
Shape bread dough into a boat with raised edges.
Fill generously with a mix of cheeses.
Bake until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbling.
Crack an egg into the center and swirl in butter just before serving.
